summary: Frontend-only layout verification for Dashboard Revenue-by-Month card vs Segments card. Login (empty fields, mock auth) works via 'Log in' button. At 1920x1080, both cards render with identical height (701.5px) and identical top (590.5px) — Δheight=0, Δtop=0, well within ±2px tolerance. Chart recharts SVG renders at height 600px (>300px), not clipped, tooltip appears on hover with correct content. Toggling YTD / 12M / Quarter (data-testid rv-range-ytd, rv-range-q) preserves matched heights and top-alignment with no console errors on toggle. Only non-blocking observation: recharts logs two initial warnings 'width(-1) height(-1) ... should be greater than 0' during first mount before ResponsiveContainer measures (chart still renders correctly afterwards).
action_items: Optional: silence initial Recharts warning 'width(-1)/height(-1)' by giving ResponsiveContainer a defined minHeight or rendering the chart after the flex parent has laid out (e.g., after first paint) — non-blocking, chart still renders correctly.
critical_code_review_comments: dashboard.css line 175: .rv-mid .rv-card:hover translateY(-3px) causes a transient 3px vertical offset while the pointer is over a card. If a stricter 'always top-aligned' guarantee is desired even during hover, consider applying the hover transform to both siblings or removing it. Currently visible only when user hovers one card; not a functional bug.

Recharts emits width(-1)/height(-1) console warnings twice on first mount of rv-chart, indicating ResponsiveContainer briefly measures before flex layout resolves. Consider explicit minHeight or aspect on ResponsiveContainer.
test_credentials: Mock auth — click 'Log in' with empty fields (per /app/memory/test_credentials.md workflow).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Height/top match verified at 1920x1080 across M/Q/YTD toggles: chart top=590.5 h=701.5, seg top=590.5 h=701.5, svg h=600. Hover on a card triggers translateY(-3px) via .rv-mid .rv-card:hover; ensure any future height measurement moves mouse to (0,0) first.
